propositions: Acceptance criteria restating generic, universally-enforced process gates (CI pass, tests pass, children closed, plan-review passes) add no signal to completion verifiers and must be flagged at plan-review time.

A new advisory 1-TURN LLM criterion 'ac-process-gate' must distinguish ticket-agnostic mechanical gates from ticket-specific deliverables using a 'reads identically on arbitrary unrelated ticket' litmus test.

The criterion must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED or AGENT_TIER), routed as ac-text-quality facet with advisory posture and container+leaf scope, and include a two-key checklist (not-applicable pass, per-AC judgment).

The rubric prompt must enumerate the reject-set (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint pass, plan-review/completion-verifier passes, merged/landed, commit-trailer/DCO) and accept-set (ticket-specific deliverable: named feature tests, named criterion update), with anti-false-positive silence-on-ambiguity rule.
Live bounded-sanity eval over committed fire/no-fire corpus (≥2 process-gate-AC fires, ≥2 deliverable-AC passes, ≤8 total cases) must achieve recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, kappa=1.0.
Registry chunk-packer must be fixed to avoid singleton chunks and balanced packing is guaranteed for all input counts ≥2.
